imageNote: View from the driver's seat on the main carriageway; ahead on the right an ambulance with flashing blue lights runs on a lane cut off from ours by a solid line and chevron hatching at a carriageway entry.
en: The ambulance drives on the lane separated from our carriageway by a solid line and chevron hatching beside the entry: a lane formed by widening the carriageway so that vehicles joining the road can gain the speed needed to merge into the main flow. That is exactly what the law calls an acceleration lane. Código da Estrada, Article 1(s).
pt: A ambulância circula na via separada da nossa faixa de rodagem por uma linha contínua e zona raiada, junto à entrada: uma via resultante do alargamento da faixa de rodagem, destinada a permitir que os veículos que entram adquiram a velocidade conveniente para se incorporarem na corrente principal, isto é, uma via de aceleração. Código da Estrada, artigo 1.º, alínea s).
ru: Скорая движется по полосе, отделённой от нашей проезжей части сплошной линией и шевронной разметкой у въезда: полоса, образованная расширением проезжей части, чтобы въезжающие на дорогу транспортные средства могли набрать нужную скорость и влиться в основной поток, то есть полосу разгона. Código da Estrada, статья 1(s).
